title: Ashbury Rewards Training Note: The Relocation Advance-Booking Supplement
content:
Under Ashbury Rewards, a relocated reservation that was booked well ahead of its arrival date carries an advance-booking supplement in points.

**What is the relocation advance-booking supplement?**
A relocated reservation booked sixty or more calendar days before its arrival date carries a relocation advance-booking supplement of five thousand points, one booked fourteen to fifty-nine days before carries two thousand five hundred points, and one booked fewer than fourteen days before carries none. The supplement is added to the relocation compensation of that reservation.

**How are the days counted?**
The days are counted from the booked date to the arrival date, both read from the relocated reservation's Room Reservations record: the date the reservation was created and its scheduled arrival date.

**What are the bands?**

| Days from the booked date to the arrival date | Supplement |
|---|---|
| 60 or more | 5000 points |
| 14 to 59 | 2500 points |
| Fewer than 14 | None |

**Where exactly do the thresholds fall? (hypothetical dates)**

| Booked date | Arrival date | Days | Supplement |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 March 2026 | 30 April 2026 | 60 | 5000 points |
| 2 March 2026 | 30 April 2026 | 59 | 2500 points |
| 1 March 2026 | 15 March 2026 | 14 | 2500 points |
| 2 March 2026 | 15 March 2026 | 13 | None |

**Does a change to the reservation after booking move the booked date?**
The count uses the booked date recorded on the reservation, which is the date the reservation was created.
